thought.text: **Sangat informatif**: tombol `Create account` **disabled** sampai Turnstile selesai. Artinya token Turnstile wajib valid *sebelum* submit. Di headless Turnstile tidak auto-solve. Saya klik checkbox widget-nya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='amsniff.py'; t=open(p).read()
t=t.replace('''        page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        print("tombol:", [t.inner_text() for t in page.query_selector_all("button")][:8])
''','''        # Turnstile headless sering tidak auto-solve; klik checkbox widget.
        for sel in ['iframe[src*="challenges.cloudflare.com"]', '#cf-turnstile', 'div[data-sitekey]']:
            fr = page.query_selector(sel)
            if fr:
                print("widget:", sel)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        try:
            page.frame_locator('iframe[src*="challenges.cloudflare.com"]').locator('input[type="checkbox"], body').first.click(timeout=8000)
            print("checkbox diklik")
        except Exception as e:
            print("klik gagal:", type(e).__name__)

        # tunggu tombol aktif
        for _ in range(20):
            if page.is_enabled('button[type="submit"]'):
                break
            page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        print("tombol aktif:", page.is_enabled('button[type="submit"]'))
''')
open(p,'w').write(t); print("patched")
PY
